title: Expedition 33: The Paintress
alt: A tower of dark stone stands in a dark sea under a sky of blue-green cloud that turns about it. On the stone the number 33 shines in strokes of gold light, inside a great thin ring of gold. At the foot of the stone sits a woman as big as a hill, pale, under long white hair, with one arm raised to the number. At the left an iron tower like the Eiffel Tower is bent over at its top. At the right, blocks of old Paris houses with lit windows hang in the air. Red and white petals rise from the dark roofs along the foot of the picture and drift over the water toward the number.
summary: A painting of the Paintress and the number on the Monolith from Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, the game by Sandfall Interactive. Far out at sea stands the Monolith, and at its foot sits the Paintress. Each year she wakes and paints a number on the stone, one less than the last.

Every person of that age then goes to petals and smoke. The people of Lumiere call it the Gommage. Lumiere is a broken piece of Paris, with a bent tower of iron. This year the number is 33. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
